responsibility: Implements the default out-of-line behavior for the abstract HIR type interface’s trait-bound conversion hook. Its `Type::to_trait_bound` definition provides the baseline null result for type nodes that cannot be reinterpreted as trait bounds, leaving specialized type classes to override that conversion when they participate in bound syntax.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the default implementation of the abstract type interface hook declared in `rust-hir-type-abstract.h`, namely `Type::to_trait_bound`, returning no trait-bound conversion by default. Unlike the header, it is not the root type contract definition but the single baseline implementation file for that abstract API.
